title: Comparison pullbacks of injective module sheaves are direct-image acyclic
statement:
Let $X$ be any scheme and let $\Lambda$ be a finite ring in the common larger universe of its small sites. Form the canonical comparison adjunction $
u_X^*\dashv
u_{X,*}$ on sheaves of left $\Lambda$-modules by [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. For every injective etale module sheaf $I$ and every $n\geq0$, one has $R^{n+1}
u_{X,*}(
u_X^*I)=0$. There are no affineness or quasi-compactness hypotheses on $X$.

lean.statement:
theorem rightAcyclic_comparisonUpperStar_obj_of_injective (X : Scheme.{u})
    (I : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A)
    [Injective I] : ν_*(X)[A].rightAcyclic (ν^*(X)[A].obj I)
lean.note: Existing signature unchanged. The theorem is reduced to affine derived global-section vanishing by an explicit injective-resolution, localization and sheafification argument. This is a decomposition, with one new affine theorem still sorry.

proof.text: Choose an injective resolution R of the comparison pullback of I. The resolution isomorphism computes each positive derived comparison direct image as the homology of comparisonLowerStar applied to R. Restrict its short complex to the affine etale basis, a faithful exact restriction functor. To prove exactness it suffices to prove exactness of the underlying section presheaf and then apply exact sheafification.

For each affine etale object V, etale pullback sends I to an injective on V_et. Apply the affine derived-global-section vanishing theorem to V and that injective. Transport via the canonical comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso. Localization of the pro-etale site preserves injectives; the already proved isZero_rightDerived_sectionsFunctor_of_upperStar transports global-section vanishing to derived evaluation at V.

Use R.isoRightDerivedObj for the section functor to conclude that every affine section short complex is exact. This is definitionally the evaluation of the presheaf short complex in step 1. Evaluation detects presheaf exactness, exact sheafification returns the restricted sheaf complex, and faithful exact restriction reflects exactness on X_et. Thus every positive homology sheaf is zero. This uses sheafification of section homology; it does not identify sections of a higher direct-image sheaf with derived sections.
